note:
37F burned the back of her hand on an oven rack 1 hour ago. 2 cm area of redness, no blisters. Cooled under running water.
Assessment: superficial first-degree burn.
Plan: aloe vera gel and acetaminophen OTC as needed.
label_note: One minor problem; OTC is low risk; only one element reaches low.

note:
21M with left ear pain and itching for 3 days after swimming. Pain with tragal pressure, canal swollen and red with debris, TM intact.
Assessment: acute otitis externa, left.
Plan: ciprofloxacin-dexamethasone otic drops prescribed, keep ear dry.
label_note: Acute uncomplicated + prescription: a prescription alone does not make moderate.

note:
52M found a tick on his thigh this morning, attached less than 24 hours, removed at home; also a blister on his heel from new shoes. No rash, no fever.
Assessment: 1) tick bite, no signs of infection; 2) friction blister, right heel.
Plan: observe the bite site, cover the blister with a padded dressing.
label_note: Two minor problems make problems low, but data and risk are minimal.

note:
44F with heartburn for years, worse for 1 month despite omeprazole 20 mg daily, now waking at night. No trouble swallowing, no weight loss, no black stools.
Assessment: GERD, worsening on current therapy.
Plan: increased omeprazole to 40 mg daily and added famotidine at bedtime, prescriptions sent.
label_note: Chronic illness with progression + prescription drug management.

note:
2 y/o F with fever to 103 and pulling at the left ear since yesterday. History from mother; patient is a toddler and cannot describe symptoms. Drinking well, playful. Left TM bulging and red.
Assessment: acute otitis media, left, with fever.
Plan: amoxicillin 90 mg/kg/day prescribed, ibuprofen OTC for fever.
label_note: Fever in otitis media does not make it acute_systemic (AMA wording); historian makes data limited.

note:
67M with sudden weakness of the left arm and slurred speech that began 30 minutes ago. Facial droop on the left.
Assessment: suspected acute stroke.
Plan: EMS called for emergency transfer to the ED with a stroke alert.
label_note: Threat to life + decision regarding hospitalization.

note:
40F seen for refills while her PCP is away. Hypothyroidism, stable on levothyroxine 75 mcg; reviewed her TSH result from last month: 2.1, in range. Depression, stable on sertraline 100 mg, PHQ-2 negative today.
Assessment: hypothyroidism, stable; depression, stable.
Plan: levothyroxine and sertraline refilled.
label_note: Two stable chronic illnesses = moderate problems; undercoded.

note:
31F fell on her left wrist while skating yesterday. Snuffbox not tender, mild swelling dorsally. X-ray of the left wrist ordered; radiology report reviewed: no fracture.
Assessment: left wrist sprain.
Plan: wrist brace, ibuprofen OTC, ice.
label_note: Ordered X-ray counts once (ordering includes reviewing the report).

note:
49M with fever 101.6, productive cough and chills for 4 days. Crackles at the left base, SpO2 95%. Chest X-ray ordered; radiology report reviewed: left lower lobe infiltrate. COVID-19 test ordered: negative.
Assessment: community-acquired pneumonia.
Plan: amoxicillin-clavulanate and azithromycin prescribed, recheck in 2 days.
label_note: Pneumonia is an AMA example of acute illness with systemic symptoms.

note:
35M with a small skin tag on the side of his neck that catches on his shirt collar. No bleeding, no change in color.
Assessment: benign skin tag.
Plan: reassurance; can be removed electively by dermatology if bothersome.

29M brought by his wife for worsening depression. He reports thoughts of ending his life with a plan for the past 2 days.
Assessment: major depression with suicidal ideation and a plan, imminent risk.
Plan: patient kept under direct observation; arranged emergency transfer to the ED for psychiatric evaluation and possible admission.
label_note: Threat to life + decision regarding hospitalization.

note:
26F bitten on the back of the right hand by a neighbor's dog 2 hours ago. Two puncture wounds over the 3rd knuckle, pain when making a fist, concern for tendon or joint involvement. X-ray of the right hand ordered; radiology report reviewed: no fracture, no foreign body. Wounds irrigated, left open. Tetanus booster given.
Plan: amoxicillin-clavulanate prescribed, hand surgery follow-up tomorrow.
label_note: Acute complicated injury + prescription; one test only; overcoded.
